item.title: Most Visible Federation
item.text: We choose sites that publish a Journal Fork Survey as the first tier of a new informal federation discovery mechanism. We then sort chronologically all sites these surveys show as  interesting. Within these we find a second tier of similarly surveyed sites. See [[Recent Changes]]

item.title: On Money
item.text: It is the unfortunate reality of the world in 2025 that any project that grows beyond a handful of interested parties needs to address the subject of money. There is a lot packed into this little five letter word, and so it's worth diving in a bit into what we mean when we talk about money.

@planetnineisaspaceship: one cool trick is the existing lineup diagram. I think there may be some performance nits to pick, but I created an example wiki page: http://eric.dojo.fed.wiki/2026-01-long-linup-diagram.html

The lineup link on that page takes the path you shared above and makes it into a link. But I added the Lineup Diagram to the end of that path. And then I did some browser console hackery to capture the DOT from that diagram and put it into a new graphviz item on a new page. I did manually change the orientation from horizontal to vertical to better fit a wiki page.

item.title: Big Reveal
item.text: It's us dummies! We value our agency, not the machine's, and every single thing that is using the machine to take away agency needs to be undone.
